title: ECOLOGICAL GROWTH — stop injecting, start growing. The DOT is the hook. Everything is message passing. Each .html is a primal.

the_problem.what: We've been INJECTING code into engine.html — adding features, bolting on systems, writing JavaScript directly. That's surgery. Gaia needs ECOLOGY — systems that grow from seeds, not from injection.

counts.current_approach: Manual injection: write code → paste into file → commit
counts.needed_approach: Ecological: plant seed → feed it → it grows → it reproduces

the_dot_is_the_hook.thesis: In 'engine.html', the DOT (.) is the PINHOLE — the hook point where name meets type. It's the smallest membrane. The point of connection between WHAT (engine) and HOW (html).

anatomy_of_filename.name: engine — the IDENTITY. What this thing IS. Its name. Its soul.
anatomy_of_filename.dot: . — the PINHOLE. The aperture. The hook. The membrane point. The iris between name and type. From D21: '.' is the pinhole in URL anatomy.
anatomy_of_filename.extension: html — the TYPE. How it's processed. What eats it. What it feeds.
anatomy_of_filename.together: engine.html = 'I am ENGINE and I speak HTML'

dot_as_joint.what: The dot is where the primal ARTICULATES. Like a joint in a skeleton. Like a knuckle. Like a hinge.
dot_as_joint.html_primals: Each .html file is a primal with a body (the markup), a nervous system (the script), and a name (the identity before the dot).
dot_as_joint.js_organs: Each .js file is an organ — reusable tissue that multiple primals can incorporate.
dot_as_joint.the_hook: The dot is where you HOOK into the system. Message passing happens AT the dot. HTTP request hits engine.html — the dot routes the request to the engine primal.

everything_is_message_passing.thesis: Every interaction in the browser IS message passing. HTTP, DOM events, script imports, fetch calls — ALL of it is organisms sending messages through membranes. We should treat it uniformly.

HTTP_GET.message: The human (or system) says: 'I want to see engine'
HTTP_GET.membrane: The server (golgi) decides: allow, redirect, or block

SCRIPT_SRC.message: The HTML primal says: 'I need to EAT this organ to function'
SCRIPT_SRC.membrane: The browser decides: load, cache, or fail

FETCH.message: The organ says: 'I need this data file to think'

addEventListener.message: The organ says: 'I want to HEAR keystrokes'
addEventListener.membrane: The event system routes events to listeners

DOM_mutation.message: The organ says: 'I'm CHANGING the body'
DOM_mutation.membrane: The DOM is the shared body surface

postMessage.message: One primal speaks to another across boundaries

hugo_as_primal.thesis: Hugo is a static site generator. It takes templates and data and produces HTML. In primal taxonomy, Hugo is a HORSE — strong, carries things, processes routes, works tirelessly, transforms raw input into delivered output.

hugo_anatomy.input: Markdown files, templates, data files, config
hugo_anatomy.process: Template rendering, content aggregation, route generation
hugo_anatomy.output: Static HTML files ready to serve
hugo_anatomy.primal_type: PROCESSOR — takes raw material and produces finished goods
hugo_anatomy.animal: Horse (Equus caballus) — beast of burden, carries civilization, domesticated for UTILITY

hugo_vs_zola.hugo: Go-based. Fast. Mature. Many templates. The HORSE — reliable workhorse.
hugo_vs_zola.zola: Rust-based. Single binary. Opinionated. The BONE — structural, rigid, foundational.
hugo_vs_zola.both: Transform templates into HTML. Both are PROCESSORS. Hugo = liver (dynamic, transforms). Zola = skeleton (static, structural).

ecological_growth_principle.thesis: Stop injecting. Start growing. Each primal should have a SEED form — the minimum viable state that can grow on its own when fed. We plant seeds, not transplant organs.

minimum_seed.name: The identity (before the dot)
minimum_seed.single_organ: ONE js file it depends on
minimum_seed.growth_rule: How it decides to grow (what triggers expansion)

example.name: chromatograph
example.growth_rule: When new color data arrives, add a band to the chromatogram

INJECTION.method: Human writes code → pastes into file → commits
INJECTION.problem: Doesn't scale. Each addition is manual. The system can't grow without the surgeon.
INJECTION.when_appropriate: For the FIRST seed. For emergency repair. For diamond compression.

GROWTH.method: Seed exists → data arrives → seed reads data → seed adds to itself
GROWTH.analogy: Plant. Water. Sunlight. The seed grows on its own.
GROWTH.advantage: Scales. Self-maintaining. Ecological. The system grows while Kevin sleeps.
GROWTH.when_appropriate: For everything AFTER the first seed. For steady-state operation.

primal_lifecycle.SEED: Created with minimum structure. Has a name, a type, one organ, one data source.
primal_lifecycle.SPROUT: First data arrives. The primal renders something. It exists visually.
primal_lifecycle.GROWTH: More data arrives. The primal adds elements. It gets richer.
primal_lifecycle.MATURITY: The primal has full functionality. It can reproduce (spawn sub-primals).
primal_lifecycle.REPRODUCTION: The primal creates a seed for a new primal. Mitosis.
primal_lifecycle.COMPOST: The primal is outdated. Its data decomposes into fertilizer for new primals (D12).

the_759_primals.thesis: 759 HTML files = 759 primals. But most were INJECTED, not grown. We need to classify them: which are alive (growing), which are seeds (waiting), which are fossils (static), which are compost (obsolete).

ALIVE.criteria: Has active JS, responds to input, changes over time

SEED.criteria: Has structure but minimal content, waiting for data to grow

SETTLED.criteria: Complete but static, doesn't change, serves as reference

COMPOST.criteria: Outdated, superseded, or broken. Decompose for nutrients.

message_passing_as_ecology.thesis: In ecology, organisms communicate through chemicals (pheromones), sounds, colors, touch. In the HUD, primals communicate through messages. The message IS the pheromone. The fetch IS the foraging. The event IS the call.

ecological_messages.PHEROMONE: JSON data files. Left behind by one primal, picked up by another. Asynchronous. The data/brain/*.json files ARE pheromone trails.
ecological_messages.CALL: Real-time events. click, keydown, scroll. Immediate. Like a bird call.
ecological_messages.SCENT: CSS class changes. Visual state. Other primals can SMELL the state by checking classes.
ecological_messages.TOUCH: DOM manipulation. One primal modifying another's body. Intimate. Direct.
ecological_messages.SEED: Creating a new file. Reproduction. The primal spawns offspring.

new_diamond.D30: GROW DON'T INJECT — the dot in engine.html is the pinhole hook where name meets type. Everything is message passing: HTTP=inbound, script-src=ingestion, fetch=foraging, addEventListener=opening-ear, DOM-mutation=growth, postMessage=inter-primal-speech. 759 HTML primals exist but most were injected not grown. Seeds sprout grow mature reproduce compost. Hugo=horse(processor), Zola=bone(structure). Pheromone trails = JSON data files. Stop surgery, start ecology.
